newsitem.title: USA: Calif. manufacturers vow to support tax measure.
newsitem.headline: Calif. manufacturers vow to support tax measure.

text.p: The California Manufacturers Association said on Monday it would support legislation to cut the state's bank and corporation tax rate by 10 percent over two years.
Earlier on Monday, Republican state Assembly Leader Curt Pringle introduced the tax measure, which was proposed by Republican Gov. Pete Wilson.
"California is moving in the right direction toward becoming more competitive with our neighboring industrial states," Association President William Campbell said in a statement.
"The California Manufacturers Association stands behind this effort and is prepared to help the governor and Assemblyman Pringle make this legislation the law," Campbell said.
